Product: visible yarn fibres, crochet loops, stitches and small handmade irregularities. Background: subtle cream linen weave.

PAGE 1 of "Little Halloween Costume Accessories" (cover): Cover artwork.
Render the finished crochet result represented by this specification (a rendered example of the finished crochet design, derived from the written patterns):
- 1 × Moonlit Bat Hair Clip [pattern bat-hair-clip]: a crochet hair accessory about 7 cm across; a crochet centre; no leaves; with embroidery as the pattern specifies; no stem; DK (light) weight yarn, 3.5 mm hook; colours: Black (Light yarn for bat, wings and ears), White (Light yarn for embroidered eyes).
- 1 × Lavender Witch-Hat Brooch [pattern witch-hat-brooch]: a crochet lavender about 6 cm across and 6 cm long; a crochet centre; no leaves; no stem; DK (light) weight yarn, 3.5 mm hook; colours: Lavender (Light yarn for hat and brim). Not specified by the pattern: petal count, petal layer count, petal shape, centre type; keep these plain, never add distinctive features for them.
- 1 × Candy-Corn Bag Charm [pattern candy-corn-bag-charm]: a crochet bag charm about 6 cm long; no leaves; no stem; DK (light) weight yarn, 3.5 mm hook; colours: White (Light yarn for the pointed top), Orange (Light yarn for the middle stripe), Yellow (Light yarn for the wide base).
Show ONLY these crochet pieces: 3 in total, exactly the quantities listed. Every visible crochet piece is one of them.
Do NOT add: extra petals or petal layers, leaves or stems not listed, extra flower centres, any other crochet flower or decorative crochet structure.
Branding ornaments (crescent moon, fine botanical sprigs) are flat illustration decoration, clearly distinct from the crochet pieces; they are printed artwork, not crochet or yarn.
Composition: one large arrangement filling much of the page on soft cream linen, natural product-photography light; branding ornaments small around the title
Cover text: title text exactly “Little Halloween Costume Accessories”; subtitle exactly “Crochet Pattern Bundle”; small line exactly “3 crochet patterns • US terms”.

CROCHET PRODUCT DIRECTION (authoritative for this crochet pattern product; it overrides any conflicting style, medium or avoid wording above). Two layers, never mixed:
1. BRANDING LAYER (Secondary decoration around the product: typography, background, ornaments and frames only.) Moonlit Meadow: a dreamy moonlit meadow, botanical identity; palette cream, warm ivory, soft blush, lavender, sage; tasteful crescent-moon details, fine botanical ornaments, elegant serif typography, subtle watercolour ornaments (allowed in the branding layer only). Feeling: romantic, premium, handmade. Any painted, illustrated or watercolour style above applies to this layer ONLY.
2. PRODUCT REPRESENTATION (The crocheted pieces themselves: the primary hero of every image they appear in.) The crochet pieces must look physically crocheted from yarn, photorealistic, high-end realistic product photography, clearly visible yarn fibres, visible crochet stitches, realistic loops, petal construction and stitch definition, genuine handmade depth and small imperfections, proper soft shadows and real dimensionality, believable yarn thickness, crochet stems, leaves and flowers where relevant. Styling: softly styled linen or neutral interior, soft natural light, clean premium editorial styling. Make the crochet piece large, with its yarn and stitch texture visible even at Etsy thumbnail size.
The crochet product must NOT look watercolour painted, hand illustrated, flat vector art, digitally painted, porcelain, plastic, like real biological flowers, like generic floral clipart.
A viewer must understand at a glance: "Those are crochet pieces made of yarn, and this listing contains crochet patterns."
